question_text: The Sangguniang Bayan is the legislative body of a municipality. Which of the following correctly describes its composition and legislative powers?

options.text: It is composed of the municipal mayor, vice mayor, and 8 councilors; it enacts ordinances and resolutions.
It is composed of the vice mayor as presiding officer, 8 regular councilors, and representatives from the barangays and sectoral groups; it enacts ordinances and resolutions.
It is composed of the municipal mayor and 12 councilors; it only approves the budget.
It is composed of the vice mayor and 6 councilors; it has no power to override the mayor's veto.
